text.description_html:
Heavy Duty Store Front Concealed Door Closer

The concealed 5030 Series PACER® is a heavy duty closer designed to fit in a narrow, minimum 1-3/4˝ aluminum transom. The double lever arm provides superior door control and the choice of finishes and arm functions meet virtually all architectural requirements.

The LCN 5030 Series is available in 3 different spring sizes:

  • LCN-5033 - Size 3 for Exterior Doors 28" - 30" and Interior Doors 34" - 38"
  • LCN-5034 - Size 4 for Exterior Doors 30" - 36" and Interior Doors 38" - 48"
  • LCN-5035 - Size 5 for Exterior Doors 36" - 42" and Interior Doors 48" - 54"

This Handed door closer is UL and ULC listed for self-closing doors without hold-open. Tested and certified under ANSI Standard A156.4, Grade 1.

Available in Aluminum and Dark Bronze finish.

Packaged complete with closer mounting plate, double lever arm and mounting hardware.

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this door closer:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
